text:
maria: Heads up — Starnav onboarding hit a blocker. Seats failing to provision after SSO finish, support ticket #54321. Customer reports error on provisioning step: "quota_exceeded" but their plan should allow current seats. Raising to CS for renewal risk.

alex: @maria thanks. Renewal date for Starnav?

jamal: Renewal in 10 days. Customer is evaluating expand to 2x seats if we resolve quickly. This is a clear renewal risk if they can't get started.

sophia: Steps we've tried: re-run provisioning flow, validated SAML assertions, cleared stale roles, retried with admin token. Error still returns on POST /orgs/starnav/seats -> 429-like response: "{"error":"quota_exceeded","limit":50}"

maria: Copying log snippet:
```
2026-03-19T11:22:03Z ERROR: seat-provisioner: allocate failed org=starnav err=quota_exceeded limit=50 used=50
```
Also tried bumping limit via admin API, request succeeded but allocator still denies.

product-feedback-bot: Noted. Tagging infra and quota-service owners for triage: @ryan @lina.

rachel: This needs CS ownership now. Risk level: P1 (renewal at risk). Proposed comms plan: immediate acknowledgement + status update to customer within 1 hour, technical deep-dive call within 6 hours, and offer a 30-day renewal extension if we cannot fully provision by renewal date. Thoughts?

alex: Agree. I'll draft the customer-facing message. Internal ops plan: Lina & Ryan to triage quota cache and allocator within next 2 hours. Sophia to stand by for any manual seat migration. Jamal to prep a commercial fallback (temporary seat voucher) if needed.

lina: Initial hypothesis: allocator cache not invalidating after admin API bump. I can run a cache flush on staging now and then on production after a safe window. Need approval for a brief maintenance window (2 min) on prod allocator.

jamal: Approve maintenance window. Customer prefers nights but will accept daytime emergency today.

sophia: I'll schedule a technical call with the customer at 2pm PT and invite support + infra. Also will prepare step-by-step manual seat assignment process in case we need it.

alex: Customer message draft (please review):
"Hi Rachel/Team — we’ve identified a provisioning issue that may delay seat activation. We’re actively triaging with engineering and will provide an update within 1 hour. We’ve scheduled a technical call today at 2pm PT to walk through next steps. We apologize for the disruption and will prioritize your rollout. — Alex, Customer Success"

rachel: Good start. Add: mention we will offer an interim seat voucher and keep renewal terms intact while we resolve.

maria: I'll post the customer acknowledgement now and link the ticket. Also adding :eyes: reaction when infra posts progress.

product-feedback-bot: Triage request created: PF-987. Notifying model team for potential downstream rate-limiting effects.

alex: Owners & immediate tasks:
- alex: send customer ack (in 10m)
- lina & ryan: triage allocator cache (2h)
- sophia: schedule call + manual seat playbook
- jamal: prepare commercial fallback (voucher/extension)
- maria: keep ticket updated and paste logs

sophia: Manual seat playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/manual-seat-assignment — will paste snippet on the call.

rachel: Escalation comms: I'll notify VP of Sales and Legal for extension signoff. Keep me in the loop on the 2pm call. If we don't have a production fix within 24 hours, we'll prepare the 30-day extension doc.

maria: Customer ack sent at 11:40am. Ticket updated with owner assignments and next steps. Link: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/54321

lina: Flushed cache on staging, reproduced issue, planning prod flush at 12:05pm PT. Expect ~2 min impact on allocator. Posting update after prod run.

ryan: Prod cache flush completed at 12:06pm PT. Allocator now returning correct counts. Running validation scripts.

sophia: Validation shows seats provisioning OK now. Confirmed manual + automated flows succeed. Customer call still on at 2pm PT for full debrief.

jamal: Great. Prepping voucher offer and renewal extension language. Will sync with Legal.

alex: Closing the loop: risk downgraded from P1 to P2. Next steps: follow up on call notes, finalize extension paperwork if requested, and add a postmortem once incident is fully closed.

rachel: Thanks team. Good response. Please add postmortem + customer impact summary once complete.
